status: declared by the pull request that closes #385 before any score was computed; the candidates, their features, the distribution scores and the model settings below are fixed here and are never tuned on a scored day; amended after the judge of #407 stopped taking a declared cut-off per candidate: the entries no longer name a cut-off, and each flag cut-off is chosen by the judge's cutoff_rule from each refit's training window
features_note: the six features of the dynamic logit and of #372's probit and quantile predictors, on the published funding panel
dropped_note: found when the first run at h = 2 was refused by the as-of rule (the feature reads the scored day's own settlement, which is not public at a decision two or more days earlier): at h >= 2 the column is dropped from every candidate and from the reference, the convention of scripts/pressure_model_v1.py (_at_horizon). h = 1 had already been scored with it; nothing about any score changed this declaration

gbm.note: the current distributional gbm, uncalibrated, on the same features: the tails the new models are meant to improve; scored for the distribution tables and, as a row, by the judge

distribution.outcome: the spread on whole basis points, round(spread_bps)
distribution.crps: discrete CRPS on whole basis points: sum over integer k in the grid of (F(k) - 1[y <= k])^2, F(k) = 1 - P(spread > k) from the model's own curve at every integer k

band.reading: the central 90% band of the model's own discrete law: [smallest k with F(k) >= 0.05, smallest k with F(k) >= 0.95]; covered when the whole-bp outcome lies inside, ends included

distribution.comparison: mean CRPS difference, reference gbm minus candidate (positive: the candidate is better), on the same days, with the judge's stationary-bootstrap interval
